text:
Maya R.: quick FYI — were hosting an external panel at 11:00am (5 guests). one guest is bringing a potted ficus and another is bringing a small celebration cake that needs to be refrigerated until 10:50am. also they asked for temporary badges and two extra lobby chairs.
Sam (People Ops): cake + plant noted. fridge space available in pantry A but needs a label. can someone confirm courier/delivery ETA for the cake? :cake:
Diego L.: i'll take the cake from the courier. asked them to ring the buzzer and leave under "loading awning" if no one answers. please label `PANEL-CAKE-3101122334` when we transfer to pantry.
Frontdesk Bot: Delivery alert: small refrigerated package for "Maya R." scheduled 10:05am. Courier: LocalExpress. Please upload guest list to `visitor-uploads/`. Max temp badges per print job: 10.
Maya R.: guest list uploaded (guestlist_panel_2026.csv). Sam, can front desk print badges with company name + pronouns? easy template: `visitor-minimal-v2.pdf`.
Sam (People Ops): yes we can. anyone able to drop the temporary lanyards at the lobby by 10:40am?
Avery K.: I can swing by at 10:30 and drop them. what about the ficus? is there a no-plant policy in the main hall?
Diego L.: plants are fine if theyre on drip tray. ill move the ficus to the east corner near the planter so it doesn't block the aisle.
Sam (People Ops): quick seat poll: 5 panelists + 1 host + 2 observers. we have 6 folding chairs and 1 bench. react with :hand: if you can lend an office chair for 11:00-12:00.
Maya R.: @Avery K. do you have a dolly to move the plant? if not, @Diego L. can you help after you pick up the cake?
Diego L.: yup i have a small dolly. will bring it to the loading awning.
Frontdesk Bot: Reminder: please ensure vendor proof of insurance is on file for external food vendors. Upload filename format: `vendor_coi_<vendor>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf`.
Maya R.: the cake vendor sent a COI earlier this morning: `SweetSpot_COFI_20260315.pdf` (uploaded). thanks everyone.
Sam (People Ops): checklist for posterity: 1) guest list uploaded, 2) badges printed from `visitor-minimal-v2.pdf`, 3) cake accepted at loading awning and labeled `PANEL-CAKE-3101122334`, 4) cake in pantry A fridge with drip tray label, 5) ficus staged east corner on tray, 6) 2 extra chairs + bench confirmed. ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
Maya R.: perfect. Diego ll text me when cake is secured and ill grab it at 10:50. see you all later! :wave:
